# link: every session state (at its floor) against every stimulus: the next state and the outcome.
# Floors: idle, awaiting and entering(e5) at 4, open(e5) at 5. A restart is a new data plane at its persisted floor, so it has no row.
idle floor 4 x hello -> awaiting SendHello
idle floor 4 x welcome_e4 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e5 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.1 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.2 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.3 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.4 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x welcome_e6_v2.0 -> idle Ignored(NotAwaiting)
idle floor 4 x floor_raised_e5 -> idle Ignored(NotEntering)
idle floor 4 x floor_raised_e6 -> idle Ignored(NotEntering)
awaiting floor 4 x hello -> awaiting SendHello
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e4 -> awaiting Ignored(AtOrBelowFloor)
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e5 -> entering(e5) RaiseFloor(Epoch(5))
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6 -> entering(e6) RaiseFloor(Epoch(6))
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.1 -> entering(e6) RaiseFloor(Epoch(6))
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.2 -> entering(e6) RaiseFloor(Epoch(6))
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.3 -> entering(e6) RaiseFloor(Epoch(6))
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.4 -> awaiting Ignored(Version)
awaiting floor 4 x welcome_e6_v2.0 -> awaiting Ignored(Version)
awaiting floor 4 x floor_raised_e5 -> awaiting Ignored(NotEntering)
awaiting floor 4 x floor_raised_e6 -> awaiting Ignored(NotEntering)
entering(e5) floor 4 x hello -> awaiting SendHello
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e4 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e5 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.1 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.2 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.3 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6_v1.4 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x welcome_e6_v2.0 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
entering(e5) floor 4 x floor_raised_e5 -> open(e5) Entered(Epoch(5))
entering(e5) floor 4 x floor_raised_e6 -> entering(e5) Ignored(NotEntering)
open(e5) floor 5 x hello -> awaiting SendHello
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e4 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e5 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6_v1.1 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6_v1.2 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6_v1.3 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6_v1.4 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x welcome_e6_v2.0 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotAwaiting)
open(e5) floor 5 x floor_raised_e5 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotEntering)
open(e5) floor 5 x floor_raised_e6 -> open(e5) Ignored(NotEntering)
